Attached: 1 image

"Works on my machine" is back. Now it's about AI agents 🙃

Your colleague's agent works great, yours doesn't: other tools, other instructions, other permissions. A new teammate loses a day setting theirs up.

Docker's answer is a Kit: one image with the agent, its tools, its instructions and the access it asks for. The sandbox checks those requests from the outside. The agent asks, you decide.

6 minutes, a demo and a plush whale 🐳

https://youtu.be/H_Pqd4AKm4I

#Docker #AIAgents #DevOps #CNCF
